summary: The boundary-checkpoint copy wait has the same timeout as model execution
compatibility: Uses VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 300 s); the healthy path is unchanged.
details: wait_for_boundary_checkpoint_copies was the only RPC on the engine step path without a timeout, so a wedged copy stream would stall the engine forever without an error. It now fails the engine after the execute-model timeout, and /health reports it.
